title: Intraoperative ultrasound-guided resection of buccal mucosa cancer
html: Positive margins (<1.0 mm) are frequently observed during the resection of buccal mucosa squamous cell carcinoma (BMSCC) (reported incidence 5–43%). Intraoral ultrasound (US)-guided surgery could improve margin status. This study included 25 patients with BMSCC treated by US-guided resection. Tumour thickness (TT) and narrowest tumour-free margin for five locations per specimen were measured on US and final histology. The US-guided cohort was compared to a historical cohort for margin status and local adjuvant treatment.
